fields.summary_ko.0: Apple (AAPL) Q4 2026 revenue of $114.5B (up 12% YoY) set record, but at 36.6x P/E valuation stock declined 1.9% to $331.90.
fields.summary_ko.1: Net income of $132.2B (TTM basis) and basic EPS of $2.11 each grew 18% and 14% respectively, but concerns arise over gross margin pressure from memory cost inflation.
fields.summary_ko.2: Apple achieved strong iPhone and Mac sales and record Services of $31.6B, but rising component costs from AI and health technology expansion remain challenge for profit improvement.
